value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto looks wet and warm. Showers until around noon, then mainly cloudy with a 60% chance of showers and a chance of thunderstorms through the afternoon. High of 24°C, humidex 28, wind southwest 20 km/h gusting to 40 around noon. Tuesday night drops to a low of 12°C. That's Environment Canada's forecast from this morning.
